notes.title: The modifications
notes.content:
The modifications were 
Removed RU47 and add Rifle from the previous version, the RU47 will be added again when I return because it is bugging when dropping when switching to another weapon, 

Removed Body Physics - parts of the Zombies that were on the ground, some people were stepping on them and it was bugging the character 

I left the Secondary Pause Menu for now - The Primary was not changing the settings as it should 

Removed Headshot Voice, because the controller is not working and the character is saying Headshot all the time 

Character animations with knife in hand, Animations were like T-Pose when equipping the knife, it has already been fixed
